Evaluation

Evaluation.Rd

An Evaluation is the core object of the Evaluation API, used to support collaborative data analysis challenges in Synapse.

An Evaluation object represents an evaluation queue in Synapse: https://rest-docs.synapse.org/rest/org/sagebionetworks/evaluation/model/Evaluation.html

Usage

Evaluation(id=NULL, etag=NULL, name=NULL, description=NULL, owner_id=NULL, created_on=NULL, content_source=NULL, submission_instructions_message=NULL, submission_receipt_message=NULL)

Format

An S3-style class object.

Arguments

id

(Optional[str]) The unique immutable ID for this Evaluation.

etag

(Optional[str]) Synapse employs an Optimistic Concurrency Control (OCC) scheme to handle concurrent updates. The eTag changes every time an Evaluation is updated; it is used to detect when a client's copy of an Evaluation is out-of-date.

name

(Optional[str]) **Required to store.** The name of this Evaluation.

description

(Optional[str])**Required to store.** A text description of this Evaluation.

owner_id

(Optional[str]) The ID of the Synapse user who created this Evaluation.

created_on

(Optional[str]) The date on which Evaluation was created.

content_source

(Optional[str])**Required to store.** The Synapse ID of the Entity to which this Evaluation belongs, e.g. a reference to a Synapse project.

submission_instructions_message

(Optional[str]) **Required to store.** Message to display to users detailing acceptable formatting for Submissions to this Evaluation.

submission_receipt_message

(Optional[str]) **Required to store.** Message to display to users upon successful submission to this Evaluation.

Value

NULL

Methods

  • Evaluation(id=NULL, etag=NULL, name=NULL, description=NULL, owner_id=NULL, created_on=NULL, content_source=NULL, submission_instructions_message=NULL, submission_receipt_message=NULL): Constructor for Evaluation

  • synGetAcl(instance, synapse_client=NULL): Get the access control list (ACL) governing this evaluation.

  • synGetAllEvaluations(access_type=NULL, active_only=NULL, evaluation_ids=NULL, offset=NULL, limit=NULL, synapse_client=NULL): Get a list of all Evaluations, within a given range.

  • synGetAvailableEvaluations(active_only=NULL, evaluation_ids=NULL, offset=NULL, limit=NULL, synapse_client=NULL): Get a list of Evaluations to which the user has SUBMIT permission, within a given range.

  • synGetEvaluationsByProject(project_id, access_type=NULL, active_only=NULL, evaluation_ids=NULL, offset=NULL, limit=NULL, synapse_client=NULL): Get Evaluations tied to a project.

  • synGetPermissions(instance, synapse_client=NULL): Get the user permissions for this evaluation.

  • synUpdateAcl(instance, principal_id=NULL, access_type=NULL, acl=NULL, synapse_client=NULL): Update the access control list (ACL) for this evaluation.

    You can either:
    1. Provide a principal_id and access_type list to update permissions for a specific user/team
    2. Provide a complete ACL named list to update all permissions at once

    To remove a principal from the ACL completely, provide an empty list for access_type.

    The available access types are:

    - "CREATE"
    - "SUBMIT"
    - "READ_PRIVATE_SUBMISSION"
    - "DELETE_SUBMISSION"
    - "UPDATE_SUBMISSION"
    - "CHANGE_PERMISSIONS"
    - "READ"
    - "DELETE"
    - "UPDATE"

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
## Example 1: Create a new evaluation in a project
    # Create a new evaluation on Synapse by storing an evaluation object with the required fields. If there are any fields missing, an error will be raised.
    library(synapser)
    synLogin()

    evaluation = Evaluation(
        name = "My Challenge Evaluation",
        description = "Evaluation for my data challenge",
        content_source = "syn123456",
        submission_instructions_message = "Submit CSV files only",
        submission_receipt_message = "Thank you for your submission!"
    )
    created = evaluation |> synStore()

## Example 2: Get an evaluation by ID and by name
    library(synapser)
    synLogin()

    # Get an evaluation by ID
    evaluation_by_id = Evaluation(id = "9999999") |> synGet()

    # Get an evaluation by name
    evaluation_by_name = Evaluation(name = "My Challenge Evaluation") |> synGet()

## Example 3: Update an existing evaluation retrieved from Synapse by ID
    # You can use synStore() to create and update evaluations.
    library(synapser)
    synLogin()

    evaluation = synGetAllEvaluations(evaluation_ids = list("9999999"))[[1]]
    evaluation$description = "Updated description for my evaluation"
    updated = evaluation |> synStore()

## Example 4: Retrieve and update the ACL of an evaluation
    library(synapser)
    synLogin()

    evaluation = synGetAllEvaluations(evaluation_ids = list("9999999"))[[1]]
    acl = evaluation |> synGetAcl()

    # Let's grant this team READ and SUBMIT permissions
    team_id = "123456"
    evaluation |> synUpdateAcl(principal_id = team_id, access_type = list("READ", "SUBMIT"))

    # Now let's revoke all permissions from this team
    team_to_revoke_from = "654321"
    evaluation |> synUpdateAcl(principal_id = team_to_revoke_from, access_type = list())

## Example 5: Delete an evaluation
    library(synapser)
    synLogin()

    evaluation = synGetAllEvaluations(evaluation_ids = list("9999999"))[[1]]
    evaluation |> synDelete()
} # }
